200.description: Proposed heads for this path, not committed.

resolvedRate.description: The rate actually used to compute proposedHeads -- either the caller-supplied plannedRate, or a measured rate fed back from labor-performance. 0 when neither was available (proposedHeads is then also 0).

rateSource.description: Where resolvedRate came from: "caller" (a supplied plannedRate, or no rate was available at all) or "measured" (fed back from labor-performance). Lets a human see why proposedHeads came back 0 (no rate from either source) rather than guessing.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, or a required field was missing/empty (empty-associate-id, empty-path-id, empty-certification, missing-building-id, missing-shift-id, or malformed-request-body).

schema.description: RFC 7807 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7807) Problem Details for HTTP APIs. Used for every error response in this service, with Content-Type: application/problem+json.

type.description: A URI identifying the error CATEGORY (not this specific occurrence). Does not need to resolve to a real page.

status.description: The HTTP status code, duplicated here per RFC 7807.

detail.description: The specific error message for this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path that produced this error.

schema.title: Problem
